note: Console log lines and Plutonium crash-text lines seen after clean compiles and readbacks, as regexes without the [HH:MM:SS] prefix. `python scripts/t6_knowledge.py lookup log <slice>` matches a slice. The cause beside each is the one found and fixed, not the only possible one. A repair that names a new line adds a row in the same task.

rows.cause: Animation-state entry without a compiled tree reference
rows.fix: Add the reference to both compiled aitypes
rows.log_text: BG_AnimStateDef_Parse ... referenced missing <anim>

rows.cause: Two members each replaced the map's animation state and tree files with their own additions; the copy that loaded named a state the tree did not carry
rows.fix: One shared service module owns the map's `.asd`/`.atr` pair and merges every member's state blocks onto the native base; members depend on it and ship no copy
rows.log_text: BG_AnimStateDef_Parse: state '<state>' ... not found in its animtree
rows.regex: BG_AnimStateDef_Parse: state '(\w+)'.*not found in its animtree

rows.cause: Animation-tree leaves wrapped in an anonymous brace block
rows.fix: Emit a bare leaf list
rows.log_text: bad animtree token: '{'

rows.cause: A client script called addzombieboxweapon for a weapon name the loaded zones do not carry; the engine faults at the first box use (last gsc error message, then an access violation)
rows.fix: Register in the box only the weapons the module's own zone or the map provides; a client script copied from another weapon's module must have its weapon list replaced, and the planner refuses a client box registration for a name no member provides

rows.cause: A per-frame read of per-player state that only the connect hook writes, for a player that never received `on_player_connect` on a DLC5 foundation; the vision manager, the power-up HUD and the sprint audio monitor all read it
rows.fix: Backfill the per-player state through the manager's own arrays from a guard script before the read runs; the crash report's last-error field names the read, not the cause
rows.log_text: cannot cast undefined to bool in _visionset_mgr::monitor, _zm_powerups::powerup_hud_monitor or _audio::monitor_player_sprint, then an access violation

rows.cause: New actor field bits in an already full composition
rows.fix: Remove the bits; reuse existing FX through owned entities
rows.log_text: Trying to assign 1 bits for netfield <name> but Client Field Set actor is out of space.
rows.regex: Trying to assign (\d+) bits for netfield (\S+) but Client Field Set (\w+) is out of space

rows.cause: A server registration ran before native init while the client half ran from a loose `scripts/zm/*.csc`, which executes after the client's own fields are registered
rows.fix: Register on both VMs at the same point: redirect the map script's `_zm::init` import on server and client to an adapter that registers, then chains to native init
rows.log_text: Client and server clientfield registrations don't match
rows.regex: Client and server clientfield registrations don't match

rows.cause: HUD strings kept accumulating in the shared localized configstring table until it overflowed
rows.fix: Bound HUD text churn; reuse strings; Plutonium exposes settextunlimited for HUD text (see plutonium-builtins.json)
rows.source: private repair record of the maintainer

rows.cause: Tracer reference registered before its default
rows.fix: Preserve parent registration order; require the default first
rows.log_text: Could not load default asset 'defaulttracer' for asset type 'tracer'.
rows.regex: Could not load default asset '([^']+)' for asset type '([^']+)'

rows.cause: Assembly counted one model, not hands plus attachments
rows.fix: Count the full assembly; remove inherited attachments
rows.log_text: dobj for xmodel '<name>' has more than 160 bones
rows.regex: dobj for xmodel '([^']+)' has more than (\d+) bones

rows.cause: Aggregate sound assets across map plus mod
rows.fix: Merge banks; it is an aggregate-load concern
rows.log_text: Exceeded limit of 32 'sound' assets

rows.cause: The map's zones plus the mod embedded more rawfiles than the pool; model-export GLBs and source WAVs rooted as rawfiles beside the compiled assets filled it
rows.fix: Mark authoring inputs `deliver: false` in the recipe (or drop them from the seed's roots), keep the compiled assets; `pool:rawfile-assets` in the plan names the largest contributors
rows.log_text: Exceeded limit of 1024 'rawfile' assets at mod selection

rows.cause: Not a defect of its own: it names the script and function the VM was in when it died. The fatal GSC line is written only to the crash text, never to the console log, so a matcher that reads the console tail alone sees nothing
rows.fix: Read `plutonium-r*.txt` as a log source beside the console; pair this line with the `last gsc error message` line above it to name both the failure and its site
rows.log_text: last gsc pos 0x<addr> <script>::<function> in the Plutonium crash text (plutonium-r*.txt)

rows.cause: The VM read an undefined value as a container. Where it was found this was the same missing per-player state as the cast above, but the line does not name its site, so any script can raise it
rows.fix: Read the `last gsc pos` line beside it to name the script and function first; where the site is a per-player state read, backfill it as for the cast above
rows.log_text: last gsc error message 'undefined is not an array, string, or vector' in the Plutonium crash text; seen in _visionset_mgr::monitor, then an access violation
rows.regex: last gsc error message\s+'undefined is not an array, string, or vector'

rows.cause: The engine script VM panicked, usually on a corrupt or mismatched compiled script
rows.fix: Recompile from source with the pinned compiler; compare the compiled bytes with the readback

rows.cause: Module script re-cut without its stock `#include` lines; the call compiled but could not link
rows.fix: Restore the includes (or qualify the call); `module plan` `externals:` rows catch it offline
rows.log_text: COM_ERROR (6): **** Unresolved external : "get_players" with 0 parameters at map load, then SV_Shutdown

rows.cause: A menu Lua path failed, often pre-existing and unrelated to the mod under test
rows.fix: Record it separately; do not fold it into the gameplay failure

rows.cause: The module was cut against a map that carried the script; the target's zones do not
rows.fix: `map-scripts:<script>` rows in the plan refuse an include or qualified call into a path the target map lacks; port the dependency or leave the member out
rows.log_text: COM_ERROR ... Unresolved external naming a stock script the target map does not carry (_zm_perk_divetonuke on Beta 2 Der Riese)

rows.cause: The mod's zone header read more image banks than the client had slots for after its startup set
rows.fix: Read only the banks the pack's images need, or consolidate donor textures into one pack-owned bank; `pool:image-bank-slots` counts the header lines
rows.log_text: no free ipak slots loading pak <path>.ipak with N index entries
rows.regex: no free ipak slots loading pak

rows.cause: Preloaded sound-bank reservation plus the fastfile's virtual block
rows.fix: Stream large samples losslessly; keep critical one-shots loaded
rows.log_text: "Out of memory" dialog at map load

rows.cause: An imported WeaponDef overrode a weapon the map's own registration list precaches
rows.fix: Keep the map's native definitions for weapons it already registers; the pack adds new weapon names instead of overriding native ones
rows.log_text: Access violation in include_zombie_weapon / precacheitem during map weapon registration

rows.cause: Registration inserted at different positions on server and client
rows.fix: Register at the same relative position on both sides
rows.log_text: Server registered <tree A> where client registered <tree B>

rows.cause: A converted donor clip kept its compiled event tail; a `rmbnt#` entry names a rumble the donor game had and T6 does not; the match ends (`SV_Shutdown`) on first play
rows.fix: Rewrite the event tail at conversion: drop `rmbnt#` events, resolve `sndnt#` events through the weapon's notetrack sound map or drop them; poses and frames untouched
rows.log_text: Could not play rumble asset '<name>' because it was not registered and loaded
rows.regex: Could not play rumble asset '([^']+)' because it was not registered and loaded

rows.cause: A script failed to link or threw at runtime
rows.fix: Read the first error line above it, not the last; fix the script, not the engine

rows.cause: Whitespace between quoted tokens lost in an entity edit
rows.fix: Preserve token separators and every original key
rows.log_text: G_ParseSpawnVars: closing brace without data

rows.cause: The client dropped the match it had just loaded; seen when a match is started from the console rather than a lobby
rows.fix: Start the match from the menu path; compare with a playable session before blaming the mod

rows.cause: A mod command was issued while a match was running or before the frontend was ready
rows.fix: Sequence: disconnect or return to the lobby first, then select the mod, then load the map

rows.cause: A call compiled because the name was spelled right, but the engine has no builtin or loaded export with that name and arity on that script VM
rows.fix: Look the name up in builtins.json for the right VM and arity; add the include that exports it, or replace the call; never stub it

rows.cause: Server-only builtin called from a client script
rows.fix: Remove the client call; keep the server precache
rows.log_text: Unresolved external: precachemodel with 1 parameters

rows.cause: The include that exports the method was missing
rows.fix: Add the direct include; resolve helpers per instance
rows.log_text: Unresolved external: setclientfield with 2 parameters
